notes: Exact DALI OBERON Series manual technical-specifications table (Table 2, p. 45), manufacturer-authored DALI A/S content mirrored at the cited URL; the table has an explicit OBERON 9 column. It gives 35–26,000 Hz ±3 dB, 90.5 dB at 1 m for 2.83 V, 4 ohms nominal, two 9-inch low-frequency drivers, one 7-inch low/mid driver, and one 29 mm soft-dome high-frequency driver. The stored woofer value represents the two published 9-inch woofers; the distinct 7-inch midrange is retained here, not substituted as a woofer. Driver count is the exact sum of the listed LF/MF and HF transducers (4). The manual specifies a single-wire connection, external amplifier connection instructions, and 50–400 W recommended amplifier power, supporting passive operation; the recommended amplifier range is not speaker power handling and power remains N/A. The table also lists a 31 Hz bass-reflex tuning frequency, which is not driver resonant frequency (Fs), so resonantFreq remains N/A. Published bounds are not a measured response curve, and the source does not supply response points or a polar/directivity dataset. Sensitivity reference is retained for impedance-aware normalization. Source: https://linqcdn.avbportal.com/documents/fa9572a7-b80e-42a9-8faf-ac9426d1f177.pdf.
